card.name: Digits and punctuation inside dates and day lists
card.fires_on: Mostly the zero in years like 2008 or 2002, and the comma or space after "Days 1" in a dosing-day list before 8 and 15. Also fires on a few scattered words and initials in titles and citations.

modes.label: Year digits
modes.description: The middle zero inside a four-digit year starting 20.
modes.example: On January 1, 2<<0>>08, there was an intense snow

modes.label: Day lists in dosing schedules
modes.description: The comma or space after day 1 in a list such as Days 1, 8, and 15.

modes.label: Scattered title and name words
modes.description: Single words or initials in report titles, author names and citations.
modes.example: Inclusive Green Growth: The<< Path>>way to Sustainable Development
